_comment: Unaccented-Portuguese sweep, batch 1: coordinators/, core/, io/. Found by the new wordlist pass in scripts/i18n_scan.py, which the accent heuristic was blind to. Several are twins of strings phase 3 already translated at a sibling call site (arduino_manager mixed _() and raw Portuguese in the same _notify_log stream; wizard_service.validate_experimental_design had _() on its first two returns and raw Portuguese on the next five). Two msgids used by this batch are NOT recorded here because the corpus already carries them: '● Recording' (pr3-dialogs-5e) and 'Aquarium {number}' (pr2-coordinators) -- the latter already maps to the accented 'Aquário {number}', so wrapping the source typo 'Aquario' repairs it.
